images.title: Modern French

images.title: Cherry red
images.description: A classic rich cherry-red glossy manicure on healthy short squoval-shaped nails. Smooth solid opaque red, no nail art, clean refined elegance.

images.title: Soft glaze
images.description: A soft blush pink glazed pearl manicure on healthy medium almond-shaped nails, subtle translucent pearlescent finish, gentle champagne reflections.

images.title: Lilac bloom
images.description: A delicate soft lavender manicure on healthy short rounded nails, just one tiny delicate white daisy accent with a pale yellow center, very minimal floral nail art.

images.title: Golden detail

images.title: Something blue
